title: GTA 6 Was Originally Planned for a Much Earlier Release
description: According to IGN Games, Rockstar Games has revealed that GTA 6 was originally intended to be developed alongside Red Dead Redemption 2.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Uncovering the Early Development Plans for GTA 6

The wait for Rockstar Games' next masterpiece has been one of the longest in modern gaming history. Fans across the globe have spent years scrutinizing every rumor, trailer, and official announcement regarding the eventual arrival of GTA 6. Now, a fresh report from IGN Games has shed light on a fascinating piece of industry history: the game was originally meant to come out much sooner than we ever realized.

### The Original Parallel Development Strategy

According to the media report, Rockstar Games revealed that it originally intended to develop GTA 6 alongside Red Dead Redemption 2. This concurrent production pipeline would have fundamentally shifted the studio's output schedule. While specific target release years were not detailed in the report, developing two of the biggest open-world epics of all time in parallel would have meant players likely would have gotten their hands on the next iteration of Liberty City, Vice City, or whatever setting awaited them, years ahead of the current timeline.

### Weighing Ambition Against Execution

As any gaming enthusiast knows, conceptualizing a massive open-world project and executing it without compromising quality are two entirely different beasts. Red Dead Redemption 2 ultimately stood as Rockstar's primary focus for years, setting a staggering benchmark for environmental detail, narrative depth, and technical fidelity. Shifting resources to ensure both titles received the necessary care was a monumental undertaking, and it became clear that staggering their heavy development phases was a necessary operational shift for the studio.

While the original concurrent strategy did not pan out the way it was initially mapped, this revelation gives the gaming community a fascinating look behind the curtain at Rockstar's ambitious internal planning.

## Editor's Take

Learning that GTA 6 was once slated for development alongside Red Dead Redemption 2 highlights just how grand Rockstar's ambitions truly are. While a simultaneous release might have given us the game sooner, staggering their development cycles ultimately ensured both projects received the unprecedented attention they deserved. It remains a fascinating glimpse into the alternate timelines of AAA game development.
